Project architecture ↗

THE MODEL BEHIND THE MAP

A workspace for deliberate work

Choose a fictional session, inspect a node, edit its estimate and dependencies, then start the work when its prerequisites are complete. Use pause, block, unblock, complete, and reopen through the allowed state controls.

Usable time = session minutes − planned breaks − expected interruptions × estimated recovery minutes, floored at zero. Time remaining subtracts recorded work. Planning margin subtracts remaining work from that balance; a negative number is a shortfall.

Minutes are user supplied, additive planning assumptions. Parallel work, fatigue, task difficulty and individual cognitive differences are not modeled. No causal or psychological score is computed.

A reopened prerequisite blocks its dependent active/completed work for rechecking. Recorded minutes and history remain. Restore adds a new history event. Saved baselines remain frozen. At 200 events, export and begin a new session.

Saving is explicit and browser-local. Exported notes may contain your text; inspect before sharing. Import replaces the current session after confirmation. There is no connection to the project’s SQLite portfolio or automatic certification of A–E readiness. Execution remains unauthorized.
